$comment: The console showcase's pack map: every data-pack boundary on the built export is here.
The console carries one mark, the brand at the top of the rail, and no footer. The top
bar's chooser adds the second boundary, the swatch that shows the pack the page is in,
and the static export carries the ground because a reader's choice is the reader's and
not the server's. The mobile sheet renders the same mark inside a Dialog that a static
export never opens, so the rail is the only other boundary the build emits.

rail.brand.why: The brand at the top of the rail is the one mark this surface carries.

header.theme.why: The chooser's swatch in the top bar, which shows the pack the page is in.
